bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
P=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
COMPOSE="$P/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
CODE=$(docker compose -p deploy -f "$COMPOSE" exec -T postgres psql -X -tA -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 <<'SQL'
SELECT 
 (CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM announcement_posts a JOIN room_posts r ON r.room_id=a.room_id WHERE a.announcement_id=15) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
 + (CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM announcement_applications WHERE announcement_id=15) THEN 2 ELSE 0 END)
 + (CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM posting_deliveries WHERE source_type='announcement' AND source_id='15' AND status='sent') THEN 4 ELSE 0 END)
 + (CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM announcement_notifications WHERE announcement_id=15 AND event_key LIKE 'application:%:submitted') THEN 8 ELSE 0 END)
 + (CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM announcement_notifications WHERE announcement_id=15 AND event_key LIKE 'application:%:submitted' AND state='sent') THEN 16 ELSE 0 END)
 + (CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM announcement_applications ap JOIN announcement_posts a ON a.announcement_id=ap.announcement_id WHERE a.room_id IS NOT NULL AND ap.created_at>NOW()-INTERVAL '90 minutes') THEN 32 ELSE 0 END)
 + (CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM announcement_applications ap JOIN announcement_posts a ON a.announcement_id=ap.announcement_id WHERE a.room_id IS NOT NULL AND ap.updated_at>NOW()-INTERVAL '90 minutes') THEN 64 ELSE 0 END);
SQL
)
case "$CODE" in ''|*[!0-9]*) echo ROOM15_STATUS_QUERY_INVALID; exit 254;; esac
test "$CODE" -le 127
echo ROOM15_DB_DIAGNOSTIC_BITMASK
exit "$CODE"
